assessment.nobel_worthiness: Biomolecular condensates reframed intracellular organization as liquid-liquid phase separation, a thermodynamic and phase-behaviour concept (P granules, nucleoli, multivalent interaction networks) that links soft-matter physical chemistry to cell biology. Establishes a genuinely new concept of molecular organisation with broad reach into neurodegeneration, signalling and gene regulation.
assessment.attribution: The 2009 P-granule liquid-droplet work (Brangwynne, Hyman) is the conceptual origin; Rosen's multivalent-interaction (SH3/PRM) phase-separation work gives the physical-chemical underpinning. Pappu and Mittag are important for sequence grammar and the physics of disordered regions but the three-person set seems the cleanest core; credit is still debatable.
assessment.maturity: More than fifteen years of independent confirmation across many labs and systems; the concept is widely adopted and stable, so recognition is timely.
uncertainties: Ongoing debate over which reported condensates are functionally relevant versus in vitro or overexpression artefacts
Fair allocation among Hyman, Brangwynne, Rosen, Pappu and Mittag is contestable
Whether the committee regards this as chemistry rather than cell biology or biophysics

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles are applied lipid self-assembly: pH-dependent charge, nanoparticle formation and endosomal escape make nucleic-acid delivery possible, and they enabled the mRNA vaccines. Very high societal impact with a clear physical-chemical mechanism (lipid polymorphism, apparent pKa tuning).
assessment.attribution: Cullis and colleagues in Vancouver established ionizable-lipid LNP formulation and scalable manufacture; Hope and Madden are core early formulation contributors. Others (Anderson, Langer, MacLachlan) made important contributions to lipid libraries and siRNA-LNP optimisation, so the split is debatable. I recall but have not verified the contribution details.
assessment.maturity: Clinically validated at global scale since 2020-2021, so impact is established. Recognition is arguably timely, though the 2023 Medicine prize on nucleoside modification covered a neighbouring part of the story.
uncertainties: Overlap with the 2023 Medicine prize may make the committee view this as already recognised
Complex multi-group credit and patent history among lipid inventors
Whether a chemistry committee would treat this as formulation engineering rather than a discovery

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Energy-landscape and funnel theory turned protein folding into a statistical-mechanical problem (frustration, funnels, hydrophobic collapse) and resolved Levinthal's paradox conceptually. A classic example of physical-chemical principles reducing a biological phenomenon, with lasting influence on structure prediction and folding experiments.
assessment.attribution: Wolynes and Onuchic (with Bryngelson) developed the funnel and minimal-frustration framework; Dill contributed lattice models and hydrophobic-collapse ideas; Fersht provided key experimental mapping (phi-value analysis). Credit is spread, and I lean to a theory-centred trio.
assessment.maturity: Decades of experimental and computational support; the concept is textbook. Recognition is overdue rather than premature, though AlphaFold's 2024 prize may have shifted perceived priority for folding.
uncertainties: Overlap with the 2024 Chemistry prize on protein structure prediction
Choice between a theory-only trio and including Fersht's experimental work
Some laureate candidates are of advanced age or deceased, which I cannot verify

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Targeted protein degradation by induced proximity (PROTACs) and molecular glues introduced a new chemical modality that exploits ubiquitin ligases, with many compounds in clinical trials. Strong conceptual and medicinal-chemistry novelty, though less central to my physical-chemistry perspective.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies proposed and demonstrated the PROTAC concept; Sakamoto contributed the first PROTAC; Ciulli provided structural and mechanistic basis for VHL-based degraders; Handa and Ito underpin the thalidomide cereblon glue mechanism. Eight credited people make allocation difficult; the proposed three are a judgement call.
assessment.maturity: Clinical translation is still maturing with no approved PROTAC drug as far as I know; the chemical concept is, however, well confirmed independently.
uncertainties: Clinical validation is incomplete, so recognition may be somewhat early
Large credit pool with separate PROTAC and molecular-glue origins
I am not certain of current clinical status

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Nanopore sensing of single molecules, from alpha-hemolysin channel analytics to strand sequencing, links ion transport physics to molecular identification and produced a commercial long-read sequencer. A coherent physical-chemical idea with real-world impact.
assessment.attribution: Deamer and Branton conceived reading DNA through a pore; Kasianowicz showed single-stranded polynucleotides translocate; Bayley engineered pores and chemistry for detection; Akeson demonstrated enzyme-controlled ratcheting. I am unsure of the current status of some credited individuals.
assessment.maturity: Technology matured and widely used; independent confirmation is extensive. Timeliness is good.
uncertainties: Whether the sequencing application is better classed as biology or physics
Dispersed credit across five contributors
Status of some contributors cannot be verified by me

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Self-assembled monolayers (thiols on gold) and soft lithography provide molecular-level control of interfaces and wetting, a foundational surface and colloid chemistry tool used across biosensing, microfluidics and electronics. Elegant and general, directly in the interfacial domain I know best.
assessment.attribution: Sagiv initiated monolayer self-assembly on oxide; Nuzzo and Allara established alkanethiol monolayers on gold; Whitesides generalised the approach and developed soft lithography. Credit is split between early and later work, and Xia's role is in soft-lithographic extensions.
assessment.maturity: Discovery dates from the 1980s with enormous follow-on; very mature, which may make it a late recognition.
uncertainties: Possibility that the field is seen as having peaked decades ago
Prioritisation among Sagiv, Nuzzo, Allara and Whitesides is contentious
Soft lithography and SAMs may be two separable contributions

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Metal-directed self-assembly of discrete cages and capsules demonstrates programmable thermodynamically controlled assembly, with host-guest chemistry, confined reactivity and molecular recognition. Conceptually rich and well aligned with self-assembly principles, though the Chemistry prize recognised related supramolecular and framework chemistry already (2016, 2025).
assessment.attribution: Fujita (Pd-coordination cages), Raymond (tetrahedral gallium cages and catalysis) and Stang (coordination-driven self-assembly) are the principal founders; Nitschke and Ward are important later contributors.
assessment.maturity: Concept confirmed independently over thirty years; applications in catalysis and delivery are still developing.
uncertainties: Overlap with previous supramolecular and framework chemistry prizes
Whether a distinct decisive discovery can be isolated
Applications still developing

assessment.nobel_worthiness: DNA origami and programmable nanostructures realise designed molecular organisation by hybridisation thermodynamics, giving a general route to nanoscale objects and patterned assemblies. Clear conceptual originality and wide adoption in nanoscience.
assessment.attribution: Rothemund's 2006 scaffold-and-staple origami is the decisive invention; Winfree and Yan contributed algorithmic self-assembly and tile and lattice architectures; Seeman, the founder of DNA nanotechnology, is not on the credited list, which complicates a fair configuration.
assessment.maturity: Well replicated and used worldwide; practical impact in biosensing and drug delivery is still evolving.
uncertainties: Absence of the field's founder from the credited names complicates fairness
Applications still emerging
Overlap of credit between origami and tile-based assembly
